question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Counsel
solution:
The correct answer is **"Advice."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Counsel"** means advice. (सलाह, परामर्श)

 
 
• **Example**: *I should have listened to my father's wise **counsel**__, and saved some money instead of spending it all.*
 
 
 
• **"Advice"** is a synonym of **"counsel."**
 
• **"Advice" **means to offer suggestions or recommendations.
 __
 
• **Example**: *She took her doctor’s **advice**__ and gave up smoking.*
 
 
 
• Other synonyms of **counsel **include **guidance, direction, and instruction**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Slim"** means thin or slender. (इकहरा, छरहरा)
 
• **"Minister"** refers to a member of the government who is in charge of a particular department or ministry. (मंत्रिमंडल का सदस्‍य (प्रायः किसी मंत्रालय का प्रमुख), मंत्री)
 
• **"Scintillate"** means to sparkle or shine brightly. (चमकना)
